title: Incipient-gap allocator and prefill fallback for paged KV to reduce fragmentation
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Background: As paged attention and KV caching scale across heterogeneous requests, we observe rising micro-fragmentation that increases kernel prefill pressure and forces suboptimal kernel choices during decode waves. Existing LRU/coalescer heuristics free space but leave small 'incipient gaps' between reservations that fragment future contiguous prefill batches. This ticket proposes an 'Incipient-Gap Allocator' (IGA) plus a Prefill Fallback policy to: 1) prefer allocations that avoid producing small unusable gaps, 2) opportunistically coalesce adjacent pages with a low-latency background compacter, and 3) provide a fast prefill fallback path when contiguous allocations cannot be satisfied, steering kernel selection toward smaller-block kernels to preserve tail latency.
acceptance_criteria: IGA allocator added to KV allocator with feature flag enable/disable
Background compaction runs non-blocking with <2% additional GPU utilization on critical hosts
Prefill fallback path reduces tail decode latency 95p by >=12% on simulated mixed short/long sequence traffic
No regression in cold-start P50 for existing workloads (+/-3% acceptable)
End-to-end e2e test that injects controlled fragmentation and validates allocation/coalesce correctness
tasks: Design: formalize gap-cost metric and allocation scoring (owner: Sofia)
Sim: instrument synthetic workload to produce incipient gaps and measure baseline (owner: Ravi)
Impl: allocator integration with page allocator API + feature flag (owner: Sofia)
Impl: lightweight async compactor that merges adjacent free pages within reservation window (owner: Backend-Team)
Kernel routing: add hint metadata when fallback path used so serving runtime picks narrow-kernel decode path (owner: Runtime-Team)
Telemetry: add histograms for gap-size distribution, compaction cycles, fallback-use counter, and kernel-choice changes (owner: Observability)
Perf: end-to-end perf runs across 3 HW profiles (A100 80G, H100 80G, L4) (owner: Perf)
Docs: console runbook for toggling IGA and interpreting new metrics (owner: DevX)
QA: chaos test under aggressive multi-tenant eviction (owner: SRE)
metrics: Primary: 95p decode latency change (baseline -> IGA + fallback)
Secondary: tail allocation failure rate (requests that hit fallback path)
Operational: compaction CPU/GPU overhead as percent of host resources
Quality: number of wrong-kernel-decisions per 1000 decodes (should decrease)
experiments: A/B: enable IGA on 10% of Dedicated nodes for 48h with controlled traffic mix
Sim: microbench with synthetic interleaved short+long sequences to measure fragmentation growth per 1M tokens
Kernel-pressure test: artificially reduce contiguous free pages and measure kernel-choice shift & latency impact
decisions: Use scoring that penalizes creating gaps <= 2 pages as high-cost; gaps > 8 pages treated as low-cost (tunable)
Background compaction will only coalesce free pages that are not referenced by recent KV access (age > compaction_age_threshold)
Prefill fallback will expose a kernel_hint to the scheduler instead of forcing kernel selection locally, preserving routing autonomy
Feature gated: IGA and async compactor behind 'iga-v1' feature flag for gradual rollout
